info.name: Guftagu User (Mobile App) API
info.description: Flutter mobile-app endpoints only, ordered to follow the actual onboarding/usage flow from the Figma design (Splash -> Welcome/Terms -> Login/OTP/Social -> Profile setup -> Home/Checkin -> Feed/Moments -> Chat -> Profile/Social graph -> Search). Admin-panel endpoints live in Guftagu.postman_collection.json instead.

item.name: Send a sign-in/registration or password-reset code (D.1a)

request.name: Send a sign-in/registration or password-reset code (D.1a)

description.content:
Works for an email or phone that has never signed up before — verifying it via
`/auth/otp/verify` with `purpose: auth` is what registers the account.

For `purpose: reset_password` the response is identical whether or not the account
exists; only whether a code actually goes out differs, so this cannot be used to probe
which phones/emails are registered.

Throttled 3/hour per identifier and 10/day per IP. In `APP_ENV=local`, the code is a
fixed 6-digit value (`USER_OTP_STATIC_OTP` in .env) rather than a mailed/texted one.

response.name: Code sent (or silently skipped for reset_password on an unknown account)

description.content: Logs into the existing account when the phone/email is already registered (`is_new_user: false`), or creates one (`is_new_user: true`) when it is not. `requires_profile_setup` tells the app whether to show the profile-setup screen next.

item.name: Sign in/register with Google or Facebook (D.1a)

request.name: Sign in/register with Google or Facebook (D.1a)

description.content: `token` is the id token (Google) or access token (Facebook) the app already obtained from the native SDK — it is verified against the provider before anything is trusted. If the verified email matches an existing account, the social account is linked to it rather than creating a duplicate.

response.name: `UNAUTHENTICATED` — the token is invalid, expired, or was not issued for this app

description.content: Shown whenever `requires_profile_setup` is true. `invite_code` is another user's `guftagu_id`; once a referrer is recorded it cannot be changed by calling this again.

request.name: Log in with email/password or phone/password (D.1a)

description.content: Never registers a new account — a password only works once one already exists via OTP or social sign-in first. One error for "no such account", "no password set" (OTP-only account) and "wrong password", same enumeration-safety reasoning as the admin login.
Same body as `/auth/otp/send` with `purpose` fixed to `reset_password`. Always returns the same message — enumeration-safe.

response.name: If that account exists, we've sent a verification code

OpenAPI operations for epic D.4, GFT-235/236 — App\Http\Controllers\Api\ConversationController
and MessageController.

Kept separate from MobileAuthPaths.php — same reasoning as that file: **if you change a
route, request or response in ConversationController/MessageController, update this file in
the same commit.** DMs require a mutual follow (`NOT_FRIENDS`) and a block refuses either
direction (`BLOCKED`) — both are 403s enforced in ChatService, not middleware, since "may I
 * message this person" depends on the pair.
